frozen: 2026-11-13, before any A02/A03/B01/Q01/T01 result was computed
source_of_gates: research_notes/مسیرهای پژوهشی تازه برای برد/experiment_manifest.json and the accompanying report (2026-11-11); thresholds copied unchanged unless a rationale is given here

data_roles.calibration: the INT10 export's 20 training files (frozen_baseline_manifest.json: split.calibration_int10_export); every precision variant recalibrates on exactly these files
data_roles.selection: canonical validation split: 195 files (frozen hash 8cc36038...), SEQ=256 windows from the canonical pipeline
data_roles.test: canonical test split (391 files, 95,404 windows) was explored many times; any test number is reported as 'previously explored test', never as independent confirmation
data_roles.statistical_unit: file (recording). Paired file-level bootstrap, 2,000 replicates, seed 20261113, for differences against the baseline; window counts are reported but are not independent samples

reference_rules.exact_specialization: must reproduce the ORIGINAL canonical reference (C-model/goldens/board) logit for logit
reference_rules.different_numerics: a precision variant is checked against its OWN versioned Python reference; it is never compared to the canonical goldens for exactness
reference_rules.instrumentation_off: an instrumented model with injection/status disabled must reproduce the canonical logits exactly

supported_iff_all: signed-probability-8 produces all-zero attention rows in >= 1 % of (window, head, query) rows on validation
windows whose prediction changes from INT10 to P8-signed have a higher zero-row rate than unchanged windows
removing zero rows (P8-unsigned or P9-signed) recovers >= 50 % of the P8-signed accuracy loss versus INT10
A02_flat_row_mechanism.otherwise: reject flat rows as the cause of the precision loss on real data; keep the synthetic observation and the negative result

A02_precision_finalist.accuracy_gate: validation macro-F1 drop <= 0.3 pp and no per-class recall drop > 1 pp versus INT10 (paired file bootstrap reported)
A02_precision_finalist.hardware_gate_for_A05: >= 15 % improvement of one post-route resource/time target (LUT, DSP, BRAM or latency) of the integrated design

A03_A04_exact_specialization.correctness: 100 % logit equality on all goldens, on the 95,404 raw test windows (C-model) and on constructed boundary cases (+-511, -512 bit pattern policy stated, rounding ties, saturation)
A03_A04_exact_specialization.continue_to_build: >= 10 % DSP or >= 15 % LUT/latency saving on the single operator in HLS synthesis; otherwise stop the branch and record why
A03_A04_exact_specialization.integrated: post-route improvement of the full design with timing closure

B01_vulnerability.continue_to_B02: silent class corruptions are concentrated: the two most vulnerable stage groups account for >= 60 % of silent class corruptions (rationale: selective protection only pays off if vulnerability is concentrated; 2 of 8 groups = 25 %)
B01_vulnerability.B02_B03_gates: -80 % silent class corruption on a held-out confirmation injection manifest; 0 false integrity flags on the 95,404 clean windows; exact match with instrumentation off; <= +5 % LUT and <= 2 extra DSP; timing closure

gates.Q01_quality: at >= 90 % coverage of clean validation windows, >= 30 % fewer accepted wrong outputs under the corruption set, false-healthy and rejection duration reported, no hiding by long rejection periods
gates.T01_temporal: >= 20 % lower p95 decision delay than the best simple comparator at a matched false-switch budget and maximum horizon, no increase in unresolved events, steady-state macro-F1 drop <= 0.5 pp; stop if simple hysteresis is equal
gates.S01_streaming: per operating point: 0 logit differences, 0 gaps/overflows, 0 deadline misses in 30,000 windows, bounded queue; an improvement claim needs a wider envelope or >= 25 % lower worst-case response under matched load
